assumption_under_test.description: One sentence: the assumption that, if false, sinks the plan rather than needing a patch.

verdict.description: REVISE only when a finding would change what gets built. No findings is a normal result.

findings.description: At most five, each one you failed to knock down yourself.

severity.description: HIGH: the plan fails or loses data as written. MEDIUM: it works until a real condition breaks it. LOW: worth knowing. CRITICAL: security only.

claim.description: The defect, phrased so it could be shown wrong.

evidence.description: Code axis: the file:line you opened. Reasoning axis: the plan section.

verify.description: One read-only shell command that settles the finding, or NONE.

confidence.description: VERIFIED only if you read what you cite; otherwise SPECULATIVE.
